title: The Rossa-Feres Tadpole Database
description: A bibliographical survey of the larval (free-swimming tadpole) morphology of Brazilian anurans, with a companion static web application. For each species, three larval character sets — external morphology, internal oral morphology, and chondrocranium — are scored as described or not described, each with its supporting references (author, year, journal, DOI). Companion to Provete & da Silva (2026, Biota Neotropica). Data under CC-BY 4.0; code under MIT.
